```{r}
source(file.path(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), "..", "_common", "repro_paths.R"))
paths <- repro_paths("Code_chapter04")
repo_root <- paths$repo_root
input_dir <- paths$input_dir
data_dir <- paths$results_dir
fig_dir <- paths$results_dir
folder_path <- input_dir

library(cmapR)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 1: Prepare the Drug-Toxicity Reference Table
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

compound_metrics<-read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "Table S3-DRP_inhibition-L1000.csv"),check.names = FALSE,na.strings = c("NA", "not available"))


my_drugs <- compound_metrics %>%
  filter(!is.na(Inhibition)) %>%
  group_by(Compound_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_inhib = mean(Inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_inhib  = max(Inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_conc     = n(),
    conc_list  = paste(Concentration, collapse = "/"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    drug_lower = tolower(Compound_Name),   # Used for matching against L1000
    is_toxic   = max_inhib > 30            # Simple binary classification threshold; adjustable
  )

unique_drugs <- unique(my_drugs$Compound_Name)
unique_drugs <- unique_drugs[!is.na(unique_drugs)]

```


```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 2: L1000 Data Loading & CPS-6 Gene Mapping
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 2: L1000 DATA PREPARATION\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

gctx_file <- file.path(input_dir,
  "GSE92742_Broad_LINCS_Level5_COMPZ.MODZ_n473647x12328.gctx")

sig_info  <- fread(file.path(input_dir, "GSE92742_Broad_LINCS_sig_info.txt.gz"))
gene_info <- fread(file.path(input_dir, "GSE92742_Broad_LINCS_gene_info.txt.gz"))

# ── CPS-6 ──
cps8_weights <- c(
  TBL1X   = -20.98158776,
  NAPA    = 20.57534422,
  PLEKHA7 = -11.15330576,
  ACSL1  = 20.77593761,
  ARL8B    = 19.05640755,
  CCDC90B    = 13.69596005
)


cps8_direction <- ifelse(cps8_weights > 0, "up", "down")

# ── Map to L1000 gene IDs ──
gene_map <- gene_info[pr_gene_symbol %in% names(cps8_weights)]
gene_map <- gene_map[, .(pr_gene_id = as.character(pr_gene_id),
                          pr_gene_symbol, pr_is_lm)]

# Verify presence in the GCTX file
all_rids <- read_gctx_ids(gctx_file, dim = "row")
gene_map <- gene_map[pr_gene_id %in% all_rids]

# Add weights and directions
gene_map[, weight    := cps8_weights[pr_gene_symbol]]
gene_map[, direction := cps8_direction[pr_gene_symbol]]

cat("\n═══ CPS-6 Gene Coverage in L1000 ═══\n")
print(gene_map)

found   <- gene_map$pr_gene_symbol
missing <- setdiff(names(cps8_weights), found)
cat(sprintf("\nCoverage: %d / 6 genes\n", length(found)))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  cat("Missing genes:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("(These genes may not be among the 12,328 genes represented in L1000)\n")
}
```


```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 3: Extract L1000 Data and Calculate CPS-6 Transcriptional Scores
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 3: DATA EXTRACTION & SCORE CALCULATION\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# Select compound-treatment signatures
sig_cp <- sig_info[pert_type == "trt_cp"]
all_cids   <- read_gctx_ids(gctx_file, dim = "col")
valid_sigs <- intersect(sig_cp$sig_id, all_cids)

cat(sprintf("Compound-treatment signatures: %d\n", length(valid_sigs)))

# Extract the CPS-6 submatrix
cat("Extracting data from GCTX (approximately 5-15 minutes)...\n")
t0 <- Sys.time()
ds <- parse_gctx(gctx_file,
                 rid = gene_map$pr_gene_id,
                 cid = valid_sigs)
cat(sprintf("Elapsed time: %.1f minutes\n",
            difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")))

mat <- ds@mat  # Rows = gene_id, columns = sig_id, values = z-scores

cat(sprintf("Extracted matrix: %d genes × %d signatures\n",
            nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))

# ── Calculate two types of CPS-6 scores ──

# Method 1: Weighted score using proteomic weights
# CPS8_weighted = Σ(w_i × z_i) / Σ|w_i|, normalized
gene_ids_ordered <- gene_map$pr_gene_id
weights_ordered  <- gene_map$weight
names(weights_ordered) <- gene_ids_ordered

w_mat <- matrix(weights_ordered, nrow = length(gene_ids_ordered),
                ncol = ncol(mat))
cps8_weighted <- colSums(mat[gene_ids_ordered, ] * w_mat, na.rm = TRUE) /
                 sum(abs(weights_ordered))

# Method 2: Simple directional score
# CPS8_simple = mean_z(up genes) − mean_z(down genes)
up_ids   <- gene_map[direction == "up"]$pr_gene_id
down_ids <- gene_map[direction == "down"]$pr_gene_id

up_z <- if (length(up_ids) == 1) {
  mat[up_ids, ]
} else {
  colMeans(mat[up_ids, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

down_z <- if (length(down_ids) == 1) {
  mat[down_ids, ]
} else {
  colMeans(mat[down_ids, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

cps8_simple <- up_z - down_z

# Assemble results
res <- data.table(
  sig_id        = colnames(mat),
  cps8_weighted = as.numeric(cps8_weighted),
  cps8_simple   = as.numeric(cps8_simple)
)

# Merge signature metadata
res <- merge(res,
             sig_cp[, .(sig_id, pert_id, pert_iname, cell_id,
                        pert_idose, pert_itime)],
             by = "sig_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Aggregate to the compound level
compound_l1000 <- res[, .(
  median_weighted = median(cps8_weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_weighted   = mean(cps8_weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_simple   = median(cps8_simple, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_simple     = mean(cps8_simple, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_weighted     = sd(cps8_weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_sigs          = .N,
  cells_tested    = paste(unique(cell_id), collapse = ";")
), by = pert_iname]

compound_l1000[, drug_lower := tolower(pert_iname)]

cat(sprintf("\nTotal L1000 compounds: %d\n", nrow(compound_l1000)))
```




```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 4: Match Study Compounds to L1000
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("  PHASE 4: COMPOUND MATCHING\n")
cat("════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")

# ── 4a. Exact matching ──
matched <- merge(my_drugs, compound_l1000,
                 by = "drug_lower", all = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Exact matches: %d / %d drugs\n", nrow(matched), nrow(my_drugs)))

# ── 4b. Fuzzy matching to identify naming differences ──
unmatched <- my_drugs %>%
  filter(!drug_lower %in% compound_l1000$drug_lower)

if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\nUnmatched drugs (attempting fuzzy matching):\n")
  l1000_names <- compound_l1000$drug_lower

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(unmatched))) {
    drug <- unmatched$drug_lower[i]
    # Check for substring matches
    partial <- l1000_names[grepl(drug, l1000_names, fixed = TRUE) |
                           grepl(gsub("-", "", drug),
                                 gsub("-", "", l1000_names), fixed = TRUE)]
    if (length(partial) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  '%s' → Possible matches: %s\n",
                  drug, paste(head(partial, 5), collapse = ", ")))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  '%s' → No match\n", drug))
    }
  }

  cat("\n★ To manually correct compound matches, edit the following code ★\n")
  cat("# manual_fix <- data.frame(\n")
  cat("#   drug_lower_old = c('your_name', ...),\n")
  cat("#   drug_lower_new = c('L1000_name', ...)\n")
  cat("# )\n")
}

cat(sprintf("\nFinal matched compounds: %d drugs\n", nrow(matched)))
cat("Matched drugs:\n")
print(matched %>%
        dplyr::select(drug_lower, mean_inhib, max_inhib, is_toxic,
               median_weighted, n_sigs) %>%
        arrange(desc(max_inhib)))
```



```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 5: Multi-Level Statistical Validation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n")
cat("║      PHASE 5: STATISTICAL VALIDATION             ║\n")
cat("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Validation 1: Continuous-variable correlation
# L1000 CPS-6 score vs measured inhibition
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation 1: CPS-6 Transcriptional Score vs Proteomic Inhibition Rate (Spearman) ──\n")

if (nrow(matched) >= 8) {
  cor_w <- cor.test(matched$median_weighted, matched$max_inhib,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  cor_s <- cor.test(matched$median_simple,   matched$max_inhib,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("  Weighted score: ρ = %+.3f, p = %.3e (n=%d)\n",
              cor_w$estimate, cor_w$p.value, nrow(matched)))
  cat(sprintf("  Simple score:   ρ = %+.3f, p = %.3e (n=%d)\n",
              cor_s$estimate, cor_s$p.value, nrow(matched)))

  # A positive correlation indicates that the proteomics-derived toxicity direction
  # is also associated with toxicity in the transcriptomic data
  if (cor_w$estimate > 0 & cor_w$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("  ✓ Cross-omics validation successful: proteomics-derived CPS-6 weights are reproduced in transcriptomic data\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("  Fewer than 8 drugs were matched; correlation analysis was skipped\n")
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Validation 2: Binary comparison — Toxic vs Non-toxic
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation 2: L1000 CPS-6 Scores in Toxic vs Non-toxic Drugs ──\n")

n_toxic    <- sum(matched$is_toxic)
n_nontoxic <- sum(!matched$is_toxic)

if (n_toxic >= 3 & n_nontoxic >= 3) {
  wt <- wilcox.test(median_weighted ~ is_toxic, data = matched)
  cat(sprintf("  Toxic drugs    (n=%d): median CPS-6 = %.3f\n",
              n_toxic, median(matched$median_weighted[matched$is_toxic])))
  cat(sprintf("  Non-toxic drugs(n=%d): median CPS-6 = %.3f\n",
              n_nontoxic, median(matched$median_weighted[!matched$is_toxic])))
  cat(sprintf("  Wilcoxon p = %.4f\n", wt$p.value))

  # Effect size
  r_eff <- abs(qnorm(wt$p.value / 2)) / sqrt(nrow(matched))
  cat(sprintf("  Effect size r = %.3f\n", r_eff))
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Validation 3: Single-Gene Directional Concordance
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation 3: Single-Gene Directional Concordance ──\n")

gene_validation <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(gene_map))) {
  gid  <- gene_map$pr_gene_id[i]
  gsym <- gene_map$pr_gene_symbol[i]
  gdir <- gene_map$direction[i]
  gw   <- gene_map$weight[i]

  # Extract the z-score of this gene across all signatures
  z_all <- mat[gid, ]

  # Construct a temporary table and link it to the study compounds
  temp <- data.table(sig_id = names(z_all), z = as.numeric(z_all))
  temp <- merge(temp, res[, .(sig_id, pert_iname)], by = "sig_id")
  temp[, drug_lower := tolower(pert_iname)]
  temp <- merge(temp, my_drugs[, c("drug_lower", "max_inhib", "is_toxic")],
                by = "drug_lower")

  if (nrow(temp) < 10) next

  # Spearman correlation with inhibition rate
  ct <- cor.test(temp$z, temp$max_inhib,
                 method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

  # Assess directional concordance
  # If the proteomic weight > 0 (up → toxicity),
  # the transcriptomic z-score should also correlate positively with inhibition (ρ > 0)
  # If the weight < 0 (down → toxicity), ρ should be negative
  expected_sign <- sign(gw)
  observed_sign <- sign(ct$estimate)
  consistent    <- expected_sign == observed_sign

  # Mean z-score difference between Toxic and Non-toxic groups
  mean_z_toxic    <- mean(temp$z[temp$is_toxic], na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_z_nontoxic <- mean(temp$z[!temp$is_toxic], na.rm = TRUE)

  gene_validation <- rbind(gene_validation, data.frame(
    Gene              = gsym,
    Weight            = gw,
    Expected_Dir      = gdir,
    L1000_rho         = round(ct$estimate, 4),
    L1000_p           = ct$p.value,
    Mean_z_Toxic      = round(mean_z_toxic, 4),
    Mean_z_NonToxic   = round(mean_z_nontoxic, 4),
    Direction_Match   = consistent,
    Is_Landmark       = gene_map$pr_is_lm[i],
    N_datapoints      = nrow(temp)
  ))
}

gene_validation$L1000_FDR <- p.adjust(gene_validation$L1000_p, method = "BH")
gene_validation <- gene_validation %>% arrange(L1000_p)

cat("\n")
print(gene_validation %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene, Weight, Expected_Dir, L1000_rho,
               L1000_p, Direction_Match, Is_Landmark))

n_consistent <- sum(gene_validation$Direction_Match)
cat(sprintf("\nDirectionally concordant genes: %d / %d (%.0f%%)\n",
            n_consistent, nrow(gene_validation),
            n_consistent / nrow(gene_validation) * 100))

# Binomial test: determine whether directional concordance exceeds 50%
binom_p <- binom.test(n_consistent, nrow(gene_validation),
                       p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")$p.value
cat(sprintf("Binomial test p = %.4f (H0: directional concordance = 50%%)\n", binom_p))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Validation 4: Permutation Test
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation 4: Permutation Test ──\n")

if (nrow(matched) >= 8) {
  set.seed(42)
  obs_rho <- cor(matched$median_weighted, matched$max_inhib,
                 method = "spearman")

  n_perm <- 10000
  perm_rhos <- replicate(n_perm, {
    perm_inhib <- sample(matched$max_inhib)
    cor(matched$median_weighted, perm_inhib, method = "spearman")
  })

  perm_p <- mean(abs(perm_rhos) >= abs(obs_rho))
  cat(sprintf("  Observed Spearman ρ: %.3f\n", obs_rho))
  cat(sprintf("  Permutation p (10,000 permutations): %.4f\n", perm_p))
  cat(sprintf("  Exceeds %.1f%% of random permutations\n", (1 - perm_p) * 100))
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Validation 5: Ranking of Toxic Study Drugs Across the L1000 Landscape
# ─────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation 5: Percentile Ranking of Toxic Study Drugs Among All L1000 Compounds ──\n")

total_compounds <- nrow(compound_l1000)
matched_toxic <- matched %>% dplyr::filter(is_toxic) %>% arrange(desc(median_weighted))

percentile_results <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(matched_toxic))) {
  d   <- matched_toxic[i, ]
  rk  <- sum(compound_l1000$median_weighted <= d$median_weighted)
  pct <- rk / total_compounds * 100
  percentile_results <- rbind(percentile_results, data.frame(
    Drug       = d$drug_lower,
    Inhib_Rate = d$max_inhib,
    CPS8_L1000 = round(d$median_weighted, 3),
    Percentile = round(pct, 1)
  ))
  cat(sprintf("  %-25s inhib=%5.1f%% | CPS-6=%.3f | %.1fth percentile\n",
              d$drug_lower, d$max_inhib, d$median_weighted, pct))
}

# Mean percentile of toxic drugs vs random expectation (50%)
mean_pct <- mean(percentile_results$Percentile)
cat(sprintf("\n  Mean percentile of toxic drugs: %.1f%% (random expectation = 50%%)\n", mean_pct))
wt_pct <- wilcox.test(percentile_results$Percentile, mu = 50)
cat(sprintf("  One-sample Wilcoxon p = %.4f\n", wt_pct$p.value))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PHASE 6: Visualization
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
data_dir <- paths$results_dir
fig_dir <- paths$results_dir
folder_path <- input_dir


# ── Figure 1: Primary validation plot — L1000 CPS-6 score vs measured inhibition ──
if (nrow(matched) >= 8) {
  
  r_label <- sprintf("ρ = %.3f\np = %.4f\nn = %d",
                     cor_w$estimate, cor_w$p.value, nrow(matched))

  p1 <- ggplot(matched, aes(x = median_weighted, y = max_inhib)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = max_inhib), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#deebf7",
      high = "#5F6A8F", 
      name = "Inhibition\nRate (%)"
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#5F6A8F", linetype = "dashed",
                linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.2) +
    annotate("text", 
             x = min(matched$median_weighted) + 0.05 * diff(range(matched$median_weighted)),
             y = max(matched$max_inhib) - 0.05 * diff(range(matched$max_inhib)),
             label = r_label,
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4,
             color = "black", fontface = "bold",
             lineheight = 0.9) +
    labs(
      title = "Cross-Omics Validation: Proteomics vs L1000 CPS-6 Score",
      subtitle = sprintf("Measured toxicity vs weighted CPS-6 transcriptional score | n = %d drugs",
                         nrow(matched)),
      x = "CPS-6 Score (L1000 Transcriptional)",
      y = "Inhibition (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir,"Fig_L1000_validation_scatter.pdf"), p1, width = 7, height = 7)
  print(p1)
}

```
